title: Avatar & LetterAvatar
description: A person or team: their image, two initials on a stable tone (`Avatar`), or one upper-cased letter (`vi` locale, "?" when empty) on a neutral fill (`LetterAvatar`, or `Avatar initials={1}`).
when: Owners, assignees, customers in rows and cards (`Avatar`).
Neutral one-letter account or sender marks without a photo (`LetterAvatar`, used by the route header's account menu).
a11y: The full name is the accessible label (`role="img"` + `aria-label`); mark `aria-hidden` when placed next to the same visible name.

examples.title: One-letter neutral avatar
examples.description: LetterAvatar draws the first letter upper-cased with the vi locale (Đ, Á, or ? when empty) on a neutral fill.
